name: Maria Isabel Santos
headline: Customer Success Specialist
summary: Customer Success professional with 4 years of experience managing client onboarding, retention, and support operations for SaaS companies. Skilled in CRM administration and helpdesk tools, with a strong focus on improving customer satisfaction and reducing churn through proactive engagement strategies.

responsibilities: Manage end-to-end onboarding process for new enterprise clients
Serve as primary point of contact for a portfolio of 50+ accounts
Monitor customer health scores and proactively address churn risks
Collaborate with product team to relay client feedback for feature improvements
Conduct quarterly business reviews with key accounts
Responded to customer inquiries via email, chat, and phone using Zendesk
Assisted in onboarding new customers by guiding them through platform setup
Maintained accurate customer records within CRM system
Escalated complex technical issues to engineering team
